labs.title: One studio. Five ways of making.
labs.intro: TMProductLab operates as a connected studio system. Each Lab has its own methods while sharing a commitment to precision, iteration, and clear communication.

process.title: A process built to adapt.
process.intro: Projects can enter at any stage and move through only what they need. The value is continuity between creative direction and technical execution.
process.throughlineTitle: Structured enough to build. Flexible enough to discover.

about.title: Multidisciplinary product designer.
about.intro: Tanaka Matsimbi is a multidisciplinary product designer working across product development, CAD engineering, visualization, and animation. His work connects precise digital modeling with clear visual communication. He approaches projects through structured exploration, iteration, and practical problem-solving. TMProductLab brings these disciplines together from early concept to presentation-ready outcome. He is open to project work, employment opportunities, and creative collaboration.
about.missionTitle: Bridge the gap between concept and creation.
missionParagraphs: The studio develops ideas into outcomes that are technically viable, visually engaging, and ready for real-world application or presentation.
TMProductLab is structured to grow: collaborators and contributors can join a project without fragmenting the studio into disconnected disciplines.
about.principlesTitle: A clear method behind every discipline.
about.principlesIntro: Four working principles connect technical development, visual communication, and the decisions made between them.

principles.title: Function meets creativity
principles.copy: Ideas must work and communicate clearly.
principles.detail: Use, character, and presentation are considered together so a strong concept never loses practical purpose.

principles.title: Precision-driven
principles.copy: Geometry, proportion, and presentation are controlled with intent.
principles.detail: CAD decisions, visual hierarchy, and final outputs are developed with the same attention to accuracy.

principles.title: Modular thinking
principles.copy: Systems are designed to adapt, combine, and evolve.
principles.detail: Projects are structured in flexible parts so new disciplines, collaborators, and prototype stages can be added naturally.

principles.title: Iterative refinement
principles.copy: Testing and revision are part of the outcome, not an afterthought.
principles.detail: Each version creates evidence for the next, turning feedback and technical constraints into visible improvement.
